# Mosaic - Adaptive Bitrate Video Packaging for Go

> Mosaic is a production-ready, zero-dependency Go library for adaptive bitrate (ABR) video packaging into HLS and DASH CMAF. It features Next-Gen Codecs (AV1/HEVC), Capped-CRF Content-Aware Bitrate, Storyboard Thumbnails, Web Preview DevTools Player, Subtitles (SRT-to-VTT), EBU R128 Audio Normalization, Dynamic Watermarking, HLS AES-128 Encryption, and direct S3/MinIO cloud uploading using AWS SigV4.

## Core Capabilities
- **Next-Gen Codecs**: Support for AV1 (`libsvtav1`), HEVC (`libx265`), and H.264 (`libx264`) with software & GPU acceleration (NVENC, VAAPI, VideoToolbox).
- **Capped-CRF Quality**: Content-aware bitrate optimization combining Constant Rate Factor with VBV maxrate caps.
- **Storyboard Thumbnails**: Automatic generation of JPEG sprite sheets and WebVTT timeline cue files (`thumbnails.vtt`).
- **Web Preview DevTools**: Built-in dark-mode web player (`mosaic preview [dir]`) with Hls.js/Dash.js and telemetry.
- **Subtitles & Multi-Audio**: SRT to WebVTT conversion and HLS/DASH manifest injection.
- **EBU R128 Audio Leveling**: Broadcast-standard volume normalization (`loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11`).
- **Dynamic Watermarking**: Responsive logo overlay with alpha opacity blending.
- **HLS AES-128 Encryption**: Automated cryptographic key generation and playlist security (`#EXT-X-KEY`).
- **Zero-Dependency Cloud Upload**: Pure Go AWS SigV4 direct streaming asset uploads to S3, MinIO, and Cloudflare R2.
- **Aspect Ratio & Orientation Normalization**: Preserves 16:9, 1:1, 9:16 portrait ratios and transposes rotated mobile videos.
- **Real-Time Progress Tracking**: Calculates accurate percentage (`0.0%` to `100.0%`), encoded time, bitrate, and speed.

## Installation
```bash
go get github.com/farshidrezaei/mosaic
```

## Quick Example (Production HLS Workflow)
```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"

	"github.com/farshidrezaei/mosaic"
)

func main() {
	job := mosaic.Job{
		Input:     "input.mp4",
		OutputDir: "./output/hls",
		Profile:   mosaic.ProfileVOD,
		ProgressHandler: func(info mosaic.ProgressInfo) {
			fmt.Printf("\r[%5.1f%%] time=%s speed=%s", info.Percentage, info.CurrentTime, info.Speed)
		},
	}

	usage, err := mosaic.EncodeHls(
		context.Background(),
		job,
		mosaic.WithNormalizeOrientation(),
		mosaic.WithNormalizeAudio(),
		mosaic.WithThumbnails(),
		mosaic.WithWatermark(mosaic.WatermarkConfig{
			Path:     "./branding/logo.png",
			Position: mosaic.PositionTopRight,
			Opacity:  0.85,
		}),
		mosaic.WithSubtitles(mosaic.SubtitleTrack{
			Path:     "./subtitles/en.srt",
			Language: "en",
			Label:    "English",
			Default:  true,
		}),
		mosaic.WithAES128Encryption(),
		mosaic.WithThreads(4),
	)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("HLS encoding failed: %v", err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("\nDone! Memory used: %d KB\n", usage.MaxMemory)
}
```
